dsk.text: Nashi, Tamiyo's son, vanishes in Duskmourn: House of Horror after following his mother's call to a carved door that had no place in Kamigawa, sending drones through and then going in with friends before the door vanished. The Wanderer asks Kaito for help, since Nashi has been missing for three months.

The Wanderer, Niko and Winter find Nashi, the smallest captive, imprisoned among wickerfolk, and rescue him. Nashi asks for help to find his mother after losing most of his crew, and he refuses to talk to the Wanderer, saying the House took his mother and they are going to get her back.

Nashi insists on continuing into the Valley of Serenity, home of the Cult of Valgavoth, and Winter betrays the party so that cultists seize the Wanderer, Nashi and Niko. The cult has been feeding Tamiyo's echo to Valgavoth.

Cultists open a box and Tamiyo's shade appears, and Nashi calls to her, but she tells him the cult has been stealing her stories and asks him to let her go. Nashi pulls his mother's scroll from the ghost-trap, and Tamiyo dissolves into moonlight.
The team escapes through an artificial Omenpath made by Kaito and Proft, and Nashi says goodbye to his mother's empty scroll and leaves it behind as they step out onto Ravnica.
